# Muhammad Rehan

> Full-stack software engineer based in Dubai, UAE, with 7+ years building
> production systems across healthcare, aviation, mining infrastructure and
> logistics.

## Summary

- **Role**: Software Engineer, Full-Stack at Gulf Agency Company (2024–present)
- **Location**: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Core stack**: React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, SQL, MongoDB
- **Delivery**: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, Nginx
- **Education**: BSc Computer Science, COMSATS (2018)

## Experience

- **Gulf Agency Company** (2024–present) — React and Angular applications for
  shipping and logistics; APIs, SQL, CI/CD and release management.
- **Phoenix Group** (2023–2024) — Senior Software Engineer. Miner monitoring,
  operational dashboards and APIs; Kubernetes and CI/CD reliability work.
- **Amadeus** (2021–2023) — Airline booking and servicing flows, including
  Saudia booking, Etihad manage-booking and Royal Air Maroc services.
- **Winsoft Solutions** (2019–2021) — Unified Medical File EMR, monolith to
  microservices migration, HL7 prescription and insurance integrations.

## Independent projects

- [FixCors](https://fixcors.com): CORS proxy utility for developers.
- [NoBoxTV](https://noboxtv.com): browser-based IPTV player, NestJS + HLS.
- [Textile POS](https://github.com/mmd-rehan/textile-pos): open-source POS and
  inventory for fabric retail.
